subject: Planning demo timing around Acme Health FY spend window
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + proposed demo slots — aligning with Acme budget cycle

Hi Elena / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the time last week. We’re excited to show a short, targeted demo focused on cost-by-workload and predictable throughput for your clinical NLP pipelines. I know you mentioned planning/approval windows on your side — I want to make sure we put the demo at a time that’s useful for procurement and the architecture team.

Proposed demo windows (30–45 min):
- Wed Nov 10, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu Nov 11, 14:00–14:45 PT

I’ve attached a short agenda and a draft SOW so procurement can see the ballpark numbers before we demo (Acme_SOW_draft_v2.pdf, redwood-demo-agenda.odt). If these dates aren’t good, please propose a week that lines up with your budget cadence — happy to move.

Next steps: pick a time or flag if we should wait until after your FY reset.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the agenda and SOW. Quick note on timing: we’re heading into a formal spend freeze for the last two weeks of Nov while we close the quarter and finalize the FY budget. Our new fiscal budget becomes active Dec 1, so procurement will only start new contract reviews after that date.

Also, several folks (including our lead infra architect and procurement lead) are traveling the week of Nov 9–13 for a field rollout — they won’t be available for demos.

Given that, can we look at the week of Dec 7 or Dec 14? If you have any pre-demo artifacts (short video, perf slides) that the team can review asynchronously, please share and I’ll circulate them before the live session.

Elena
Director, Infrastructure | Acme Health
elena@acmehealth.com

We can absolutely move this to the week of Dec 7 or Dec 14. Quick options from our side (all 30–45m):
- Tue Dec 8, 11:00–11:45 PT
- Thu Dec 10, 09:00–09:45 PT
- Wed Dec 16, 14:00–14:45 PT

I’ll attach a 6-minute recording that walks through performance metrics and our cost controls so you can circulate it to folks who can’t make the live session. If procurement wants to review the SOW earlier we can provide a redlined cost spreadsheet.

Vivek — putting you on the thread in case we need to expedite any commercial flex for timing around their FY kickoff.

Best,
Naomi

Putting a note here — if Acme needs to push the demo until after Dec 1 because of their FY reset, we should offer a brief time-limited onboarding credit or a short-term pilot pricing to avoid losing momentum. Laura, can you draft a 60-day pilot quote and a < 30k onboarding credit option we can present? Keep it high-level; Naomi will tailor to their numbers.

If procurement asks for written approval for the credit, I’ll sign off. Attaching a short internal memo for the credit play (discount-approval-memo.pdf).

Thanks,
Vivek
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

Dec 8 at 11:00 PT should work for the core group (I’ll confirm with infra, but they’re back in-office by then).
